headline: Brewers Climb, Rays Surge Late
caption:
Six teams on the chart, two still standing. Here's how our model's World Series chances moved since the playoffs began.

Milwaukee is the biggest riser: 26% at the start, 67% now, just off a 69% peak. Tampa Bay rose from 10% to 33%, and most of that came today alone, a 22-point jump from 11% to 33%.

The biggest faller is the Dodgers: 24% at the start, as high as 37%, now eliminated. Cleveland peaked at 20%, the Yankees at 17%, and the White Sox climbed from 3% to 9% before going out.

The model leans Brewers, but 33% is a real chance for the Rays. Who takes it?
